historical_i2_preflight.interpretation: All 20 selected published cases were accepted by their historical authoritative I2 reconciliation reports.
historical_i2_preflight.caveat: Historical report serialization and exactness semantics are heterogeneous. PASS may represent exact equality, zero-delta field checks, candidate-match checks, or tolerance-based numerical reconciliation depending on the run generation.

reproducibility.reason: The repository contains no existing LLM/model execution runner (no generateText/streamText/OpenAI/AI SDK invocation path).

conclusion: The V2 benchmark corpus, campaign protocol, normalization layer, and statistical evaluators are ready. True LLM reproducibility is not yet measured and must not be inferred from historical I2 reconciliation.
